claim: Bounded cross-backend supplied-text timing compatibility, not acoustic boundary accuracy
original_scalar_gate: Retain max_absolute_error < 0.0001 and its failed Windows results separately; this protocol does not replace or relabel them

selection.original: All six original crops and ordered columns; append needed transcript columns without changing the original ten
selection.librispeech: First complete retained utterance per known speaker in frozen ordinary-cases.json order; require start=0, end=source_samples, WAV length=source_samples, 400..392000 samples. Fail if any speaker has no complete retained utterance. Never pair a cropped waveform with its full transcript.
selection.derived: en_us-0 raw float32 PCM divided by 256; en_us-0 multiplied by 4 and clipped to [-1,1]. Preserve its full transcript. These are stress controls, not independently labelled boundary references.

execution.boundary: Actual Rust Network::scores on raw PCM, including its own normalization and admitted model loading; actual core Vocabulary::align and reading-turn projection replay
execution.repetitions: Two complete passes in frozen case order, requiring bit-exact scores per backend across intervening requests
execution.freeze: Write and hash complete cases.json, raw PCM and source transcripts before either backend produces new scores; capture Mac once and seal its receipt before the Windows pass. Preserve failed outputs; no case substitution or tuning on results.

criteria.numeric: Finite nonpositive gathered log probabilities; exact frame geometry, ordered column IDs, model/vocabulary identity; selected-column exp sums <= exp(0.001); exact same-backend repeats
criteria.original: Report all six unchanged ten-column scalar comparisons. Original whole supplied-text character frames and word envelopes must remain exact.
criteria.natural: Identical raw text, Unicode offsets, normalization, character/word inventory, acceptance/status/reason and repeated-token handling. Each emitted frame and cell/word envelope may differ by at most 320 samples (20 ms), a prospectively selected cross-backend difference budget, not quantization equivalence. Word envelopes must be derived consistently from accepted cells.
criteria.reading_turns: Identical text-offset partitions, speakers and attribution under the same frozen activity: single speaker; alternating speakers at half the crop; overlap centered at half the crop; and transitions at every admitted Mac word boundary with offsets -4000,-320,0,320,4000 samples. Keep exact existing two-voice activity replay. Do not use Windows results to select the activity sequence.
criteria.invalid_requests: Reject empty/nonfinite/oversized PCM and missing/out-of-range IDs; sub-400-sample input has zero frames; cancellation is not a score and does not poison the following request
criteria.provenance: Windows has its own exact model/provider/functional-policy tuple and timing_accuracy_calibrated_languages=[] for every language, including English. Never inherit the Mac AMI calibration.
